enriched.title: Vocabulário de Negócios e Pronúncia de Termos Financeiros
enriched.summary: A aula aborda vocabulário relacionado a negócios e finanças, como precificação, empreendedorismo e taxas. Também inclui a pronúncia correta de palavras-chave e conceitos gramaticais importantes.

vocabulary.definition: The amount of money required to purchase something.
examples: The price of oil has increased significantly.
What is the price of this product?

vocabulary.definition: The process of determining the cost of a product or service.
examples: The company is working on its pricing strategy.

vocabulary.definition: Having a strong effect or influence on someone or something.
examples: The entrepreneur delivered an impactful presentation.
Her ideas were impactful and innovative.

vocabulary.definition: Used to emphasize doing something despite being aware of the circumstances.
examples: Even knowing the risks, they invested in the project.
She helped him even knowing he might betray her trust.
She was worried about the results.
He looked worried before the meeting.

vocabulary.definition: Relating to politics, especially international relations, as influenced by geographical factors.
examples: The geopolitical tensions affected oil prices.
Geopolitical issues often influence global markets.

vocabulary.definition: A unit of measurement for oil, equivalent to 42 US gallons.
examples: The price of an oil barrel has risen recently.
They produce 1,000 oil barrels per day.

vocabulary.definition: Estimated or planned for a future time.
examples: The profits are projected to increase by 20%.
The company projected higher revenue for the next quarter.

vocabulary.definition: A person who starts a business, taking financial risks in the hope of profit.
examples: The entrepreneur launched a successful startup.

culturalNotes: Empreendedorismo é uma área em crescimento global, especialmente em países em desenvolvimento.
studyTips: Pratique a pronúncia de termos financeiros com gravações de áudio.
Use as palavras do vocabulário em frases do seu dia a dia para fixação.
originalExamples: The price of oil has increased significantly. (O preço do petróleo aumentou significativamente.)
The company is working on its pricing strategy. (A empresa está trabalhando em sua estratégia de precificação.)
The entrepreneur launched a successful startup. (O empreendedor lançou uma startup de sucesso.)
